content.comment_body: Hello, I've noticed that there is no option to use Greek language in the message text. Is there any way to enter Greek characters or add Greek fonts to the menu? Thanks in advance.
No, Greek language is not currently supported.

analysis.insight_summary: The discussion highlights a limitation of the product: Greek characters and fonts cannot be used in message texts or menus, as Greek language support is unavailable. This impacts users who require Greek for communication or localization.
analysis.user_expectations: Users want the product to support Greek language and fonts to enable writing messages and customizing menus in Greek.
